description: §52.8/§19.6 — an `if=` on a tag whose emit dispatch RETURNS BEFORE the §17.1 mount gate (`<errorBoundary>`) never produces a `<template>`: the boundary emits `<div data-scrml-error-boundary>` and walks its children LIVE. So the enclosed server-authority <each> KEEPS its SSR first-paint render and fires NO I-SSR-EACH-CLIENT-RENDERED. The guard against suppressing a server first paint that works.
rationale: g-ssr-each-under-if-blank-paint (S433 fix round) — the INVERTED defect found by adversarial review. Mirroring emit-html's `if=` gate PREDICATE (`isGateableIfValue`) is not the same as mirroring its DISPATCH: the predicate says whether the gate would accept the value, never whether control flow reaches the gate. The first cut of the fix suppressed the renderer here and emitted a lint whose reason was factually false — measured as 2 rows painted before, 0 after, at exit 0. The bypass set is derived by enumerating every `return` above the gate in emitNode's markup branch; this case fails if that mirror is dropped or if a future dispatch reorder is not carried into it.
